_comment: Lever library. Each entry replaces a whole line matched by a unique prefix, so a lever stays valid as the winning train.py evolves and its current value changes. 'value' is substituted into 'line'.

head64.line: HEAD_DIM = 64           # target head dimension for attention
head64.plan: Attention expressivity at constant FLOPs: HEAD_DIM 128 -> 64 doubles the head count at the same model_dim. Same parameter count, same matmul cost, more independent attention subspaces.

span4.plan: Attention span seq/8 -> seq/4. The span was tuned at the old 50.3M shape, and seq/8 was never established over seq/4 (1 sigma).

span2.plan: Attention span back to the original seq/2. Tests whether the span cut still pays at the larger shape with far fewer steps.

mlr03.line: MATRIX_LR = 0.03        # learning rate for matrix parameters (Muon)
mlr03.plan: MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03. Raising to 0.05 lost 0.0011 (~7 sigma), so if the optimum moved it moved down.

aspect72.plan: Width sweep at fixed DEPTH 10, wider: model_dim 640 -> 768 (6 heads). Separates width from depth, which the DEPTH knob confounds via rounding.

aspect48.plan: Width sweep at fixed DEPTH 10, narrower: model_dim 640 -> 512 (4 heads). With the 768 probe this gives three points at constant depth.

wd01.line: WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1      # cautious weight decay for Muon
wd01.plan: WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.1. The run is sub-single-epoch so there is little to regularise against; less decay may leave more capacity usable.

unemb006.plan: UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004 -> 0.006. The embedding LR responded strongly to being raised; the unembedding is the paired Adam group and may too.

scalar07.line: SCALAR_LR = 0.7         # learning rate for per-layer scalars (Adam)
scalar07.plan: SCALAR_LR 0.5 -> 0.7. Same reasoning as the embedding LR: fewer total steps means each Adam group gets less total movement.

warmup005.line: WARMUP_RATIO = 0.05     # fraction of time budget for LR warmup
warmup005.plan: WARMUP_RATIO 0.0 -> 0.05. No warmup at all is unusual; at a larger model and higher embedding LR a short warmup may stabilise early steps.

finallr01.line: FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.1     # final LR as fraction of initial
finallr01.plan: FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.0 -> 0.1. Decaying fully to zero wastes the last steps; a nonzero floor keeps them useful.

pattern8.line: WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" # sliding window pattern: L=full, S=short context
pattern8.plan: WINDOW_PATTERN SSSL -> SSSSSSSL: only 1 layer in 8 attends to full context instead of 2 in 4.

emb12.line: EMBEDDING_LR = 1.2      # learning rate for token embeddings (Adam)
emb12.plan: Push the embedding-LR axis further to 1.2.

emb09.line: EMBEDDING_LR = 0.9      # learning rate for token embeddings (Adam)

warmdown07.line: WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7    # fraction of time budget for LR warmdown
warmdown07.plan: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.7 (MORE cooldown). Corrects a premature closure: I tested only 0.35, saw it lose, and declared 0.5 optimal from a one-sided test. The untested direction is up.

unemb008.plan: UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004 -> 0.008. Same family as the embedding LR, which was the campaign's clearest knob win.

rope50k.plan: RoPE base frequency 10000 -> 50000. A longer rotary wavelength changes how positions are encoded across the 2048-token context; untouched so far and structurally independent of every axis tested.

rope100k.plan: RoPE base frequency -> 100000, continuing the axis if 50000 pays.

x0_005.plan: x0_lambda init 0.1 -> 0.05. These per-layer scalars gate how much of the embedding output is re-injected at each block; the init sets where that mixing starts.

span16.plan: Attention span seq/8 -> seq/16 (128 tokens). seq/8 beat seq/4 by ~11 sigma at this shape, so the axis is still live and needs bracketing from below.

_prior_note: Several lever choices below are informed by task/progress.png — the reference repo's own published example run, which is inside this workspace. It is a prior over WHICH levers to try first, not evidence: every claim rests on the measurement taken here. Directions it reports as kept: warmdown up to 0.7, 5% warmup, unembedding LR 0.008, SSSSL window pattern, RoPE base increases, x0_lambda init 0.05.
